broadcast.name: Broadcast
broadcast.description: Send a message on the channel, or as a direct message, configured in the Hermes entry. Long text is split to fit the Meshtastic payload without cutting a character in half. Meant for notifications from automations.

config_entry_id.name: Hermes instance
config_entry_id.description: The Hermes entry to send from.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to send. It is split if it exceeds the byte limit.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Channel index to send on. Leave it empty to use the one configured in the entry; set it to reach a different channel without adding a second Hermes instance.

send_direct.name: Send direct message
send_direct.description: Send a message to a single node instead of the channel configured in the entry. On firmware with PKC the message is encrypted for that node alone.

config_entry_id.name: Hermes instance
config_entry_id.description: The Hermes entry whose gateway sends the message.

node_id.name: Recipient node
node_id.description: Node number of the Meshtastic node to write to.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to send. It is split if it exceeds the byte limit.

archive_hike.name: Archive a hike
archive_hike.description: Read a walk back out of the Home Assistant recorder and keep it: the track, a summary and any alarms that fired. Call it when hike mode is switched off. The recorder purges after ten days, so a walk that is not archived is a walk that will be gone.

entity_id.name: Tracker
entity_id.description: The device tracker of the node that was carried.

started.name: Started at
started.description: When the walk began. Everything recorded between then and now is read.

name.name: Name
name.description: A name for the walk. The date is used when this is left empty.

record_hike_event.name: Record a hike alarm
record_hike_event.description: Note that an alarm fired during the current walk, so it can be explained later next to the numbers that were true at the time. Kept in memory and filed with the walk when it is archived.
